name: FaceSwap.free
tagline: Swap a face in photos and short GIFs with four free online AI models
description:
FaceSwap.free is an online AI face-swap tool for still photos and short animated GIFs. Users choose a target image, provide a source face and select one of four models before downloading a result. The web tool works without an account and has no total swap allowance, while a short per-minute limit protects against automated abuse.

Photo processing uploads aligned face crops. Animated GIFs are uploaded as complete files and have size, duration and frame limits. Results include small semi-transparent watermarks. The online workflow does not process video files; those and batch jobs use the separate ClapClip Windows app, where exports require an in-app purchase. Use only your own face or faces with permission, and review the output rather than presenting edited media as an unaltered original.
